profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Hello! I'm a software engineer and Flatiron graduate. I coded here and there before deciding to study at Flatiron and I'm so happy I did. For years, I've been wanting to code professionally and now I can do that while still having fun. I enjoy problem-solving and debugging and programming seems to fulfill those needs for me. As someone who enjoys puzzles, creating projects seem like a game to me.
When I'm not coding, I'm gaming or listening to music. 
GitHub - https://github.com/JavanteS

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Completed the Full-Stack Developer Training for Java Stream and Generic
Worked on e-commerce SPA in Front-End with Angular and Back-End with Spring Boot
Technologies: Angular, JAVA, React.js

positions.title: Technical Coach
positions.description:
Debug coding errors in Ruby, Rails, Javascript, React, Redux and SQL quickly with 13 students daily through chats and screen share

Build strong relationships with individual students that foster a positive educational environment and student growth

Provide feedback and clarification on programming concepts including object-oriented programming and method scope to improve student independence as coders

positions.title: English Second Language Teacher
positions.description:
Tutor up to 12 foreign students weekly in English language comprehension skills

Secured numerous long-term bookings by building and maintaining relationships with students and parents

Create fun and stimulating educational content to engage students 

Grade student work and provide feedback to both students and parents on a daily basis

positions.title: Business Employement Rep.
positions.description:
Retained interest in workplace training and maximized receptive learning by educating special-needs students using hands-on instructional techniques 

Supported student learning objectives through personalized and small-group assistance to amplify class instruction 

Improved 20 students’ employability by tracking resumes job inquiries and skill-sets

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin

projects.title: Food-fit-Diary
projects.description:
Built front-end with HTML/CSS and React/Redux 
Implemented Active Record Validations to prevent bad data from being stored in the database 
Used SQLite and Active Record to code DB logic

projects.title: Game Tracker
projects.description:
Used active record validations to control how data entered is saved into the database 
Used active record associations to build has_many and belongs to relationships between models
Added three attributes for each model: User’s model has username, email address, and password, and Game’s model has title, genre, and platform
